Copse End.road: Narrow cul-de-sac without centre line, joining a wider road with grass verges; no humps or bays.
Copse End.note: Small 1970s/80s cul-de-sac of red-brick detached houses and a chalet/garage block, behind tall laurel hedges and mature trees.

Newton Avenue.road: Residential estate road without centre line, block-paved driveways off it, some kerbside parking.
Newton Avenue.note: 1970s estate of red/orange brick semis and short terraces with white cladding panels at first floor, open-plan lawns and block-paved drives; one view was all hedge.

Jordan Close.road: Cul-de-sac with turning head, no markings, block-paved drives straight off the kerb.
Jordan Close.note: 1970s detached houses in buff-brown brick with brown concrete tile roofs, open-plan front lawns and paved drives, wooded backdrop.

Gifford Close.road: Narrow cul-de-sac without markings, white parking line by drives.
Gifford Close.note: 1970s brick terraces with tiled canopy over the ground floor, block-paved drives, a mix of open lawns, low shrubs and fences.

Ragley Mews.road: Narrow mews cul-de-sac without centre line, gravel and block drives.
Ragley Mews.note: 1970s terraces in buff brick with white weatherboard cladding across the first floor and a tiled canopy roof over the ground floor; open-plan fronts with some low fences.

Uppingham Gardens.road: Small cul-de-sac without markings, grass verges, a big oak on the corner.
Uppingham Gardens.note: 1970s semis in orange-brown brick with white weatherboard cladding at first floor, open lawns and mature oaks; partly hidden by trees.

Rowallan Close.road: Curving cul-de-sac, no markings, gravel and block drives.
Rowallan Close.note: 1970s red-brick semis and short terraces with white cladding at first floor and tiled canopy over the ground floor; open lawns, a few fences and low walls.

Hertford Close.road: Narrow cul-de-sac without markings; block-paved drives and a footpath with lamp post.
Hertford Close.note: 1970s semis and short terraces with brick ground floors, white cladding across the first floor and a tiled pent canopy between; paved drives, some fences and shrubs.

Kelso Mews.note: Small close of plain orange-red brick detached houses with garages, low picket fences and tall conifer hedges; one view was only hedge.

Chestnut Avenue.road: Estate road without centre line, block-paved drives; narrow footpaths.
Chestnut Avenue.note: 1970s link-semis and terraces in brown brick with white or grey weatherboarding at first floor, garages between; front fences, low brick walls and open drives mixed.

Chiltern Heights.road: Pano is on Chiltern Road at the junction: wider road without centre line, give-way markings at side roads, grass verges.
Chiltern Heights.note: Both views show Chiltern Road (2012 imagery) beside the close rather than the close itself: interwar red-brick and rendered semis behind tall conifers, hedges and fences.

Almond Drive.road: Narrow estate road with double yellow lines at the corners, no centre line.
Almond Drive.note: 1970s buff-brown brick terraces and semis with white cladding panels upstairs, integral garages and paved drives; wooden fences and big hedges on corners.

Stirling Close.road: Cul-de-sac, no markings, wide block-paved forecourts to the kerb.
Stirling Close.note: 1970s brick semis/terraces with white cladding at first floor and a tiled canopy over the ground floor, flat-roofed garages, big block-paved forecourts with low brick walls.

Thetford Mews.road: Narrow mews cul-de-sac, no markings, block-paved drives.
Thetford Mews.note: 1970s brown-brick semis and terraces, some with white cladding upstairs and tiled canopies; panel fences and picket fences in front, palms and shrubs.

Illingworth Avenue.road: Narrow estate road without markings, block-paved drives, small grass verges with lamp posts.
Illingworth Avenue.note: 1970s buff-brown brick semis with integral garages, some white cladding at first floor and flat-roofed porches; open lawns mixed with tall panel fences.

Michaels Chase.note: No Street View imagery at this point (black pano, 'no imagery available' message) on both views after a retry.

Moss Close.note: No Street View imagery at this point (black pano) on both views after a retry.

Harmont Gate.road: Pano is on Peppard Road at the gate: a main road with SCHOOL KEEP CLEAR zigzags, give-way markings, wide pavements, no centre line visible.
Harmont Gate.note: Both views show Peppard Road beside the gate (school building, big oaks, tall hedges, a bungalow and older rendered/brick houses), not the houses in Harmont Gate itself.

Eynsford Close.road: Narrow cul-de-sac without markings, cars parked on the kerb.
Eynsford Close.note: 1970s brown-brick houses mostly hidden behind shrubs, trees and high panel fences; little of the houses is visible.

Ilchester Mews.road: Cul-de-sac with turning head, no markings, block-paved drives.
Ilchester Mews.note: 1970s brick semis and terraces, some with white panels upstairs and a tiled canopy over the ground floor; open lawns, low brick walls and shrubs.

Melford Green.road: Narrow lane-like close, no markings, block-paved forecourts.
Melford Green.note: 1970s red-brick terraces with white panels at first floor and a tiled canopy, big block-paved forecourts, panel fences and tall conifer hedges.

Shakespeare Close.road: Narrow cul-de-sac without markings, block-paved drives, lamp posts on small verges.
Shakespeare Close.note: 1970s red/orange brick semis and terraces with garages, a few white panels upstairs; brick side walls, panel fences, shrubs and open drives.

Farleigh Mews.note: 1970s buff-brown brick terraces with white weatherboard on the first floor and flat-roofed garage fronts; open lawns, with tall panel fences on the side plots.
